article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
The world's largest school
City Montessori School in Lucknow, India, is the world's largest school. Nearly 50,000 pupils (21).................. classes there every day, and the school (22) .................. over 4,000 staff, including teachers, cleaners, and electricians. The students learn traditional subjects such as geography and maths, and also discuss topics like world peace.
Dr Jagdish Gandhi set (23).................. the school in 1959. It was hard work, and at first, he had to (24).................. people to send their children to the school. But now, students come to him from all over the city.
At such a large school, pupils have to work hard to get (25).................. by the teachers. One pupil says: 'If you're chosen for a school team, you can certainly feel (26)...................' Another pupil explains what he likes best: 'Being at the world's largest school means you can make lots of friends.'

questions.explanation:
B. attend
“attend classes” 为固定搭配，意为 “上课”，符合语境。
A. arrive（到达）需加介词 “at” 后接地点，不能直接接 “classes”；C. go（去）需搭配 “to”，即 “go to classes”；
D. study（学习）为不及物动词，后接 “classes” 需加介词 “in”。
拓展：“attend” 常见搭配还有 “attend a meeting（参会）”“attend a lecture（听讲座）”，强调 “出席并参与” 的动作。

A. employs
学校 “雇佣” 超过 4000 名员工，“employ” 表示 “雇佣”，符合逻辑。
B. receives（收到）、C. gets（获得）、D. owns（拥有）均不能准确表达 “雇佣员工” 的关系。
拓展：“employ” 的名词形式为 “employment（就业）” 或 “employer（雇主）”，反义词为 “unemploy（解雇）”。

D. up
“set up” 为固定短语，意为 “建立、创办”，此处指 Dr. Gandhi 创办学校。
A. set in（开始发生）、B. set off（出发）、C. set out（着手）均不符合语境。
拓展：“set” 相关短语：set aside（留出）set down（写下）set about doing（开始做）

C. persuade
初期他需要 “说服” 人们送孩子来上学，“persuade sb. to do sth.” 表示 “劝说某人做某事”。
A. explain（解释）后接 “to sb.”，不接不定式；B. hope（希望）不能接 “sb. to do”；D. suggest（建议）后接动名词或从句。
拓展：“persuade” 强调 “通过劝说使某人同意”，近义词有 “convince”，但 “convince” 更侧重 “使信服”。

C. Noticed
“get noticed by teachers” 表示 “被老师注意到”，“noticed” 为过去分词表被动，符合 “学生努力让老师关注自己” 的语境。
A. thought（认为）、B. looked（看）、D. talked（谈论）均无法构成 “被注意” 的含义。
拓展：“get + 过去分词” 结构表被动，如 “get dressed（穿衣）”“get lost（迷路）”。

B. proud
被选入校队会感到 “自豪”，“proud” 符合情感逻辑。
A. good（好的）、C. positive（积极的）、D. happy（开心的）虽合理，但 “proud” 更强调因成就而产生的自豪感。
拓展：“proud” 的常用搭配：be proud of（为…… 骄傲）take pride in（以…… 为傲）
